d:
Amerika men rahne vale anant sinh ke damad rishikesh kumar ne manish kashyap ke samne bihar ki sarkon ka mudda uthaya. rishikesh ne bihta ki sarak ki badhali par saval uthate hue kaha ki 12 sal pahle jo sthiti thi, aaj bhi halat men khas badlav nahin dikh raha hai. dekhie manish kashyap aur anant sinh ke damad ke bich huee yah dilchasp batchit.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
